The '''Hoth Republic Orbital Station''' was a [[Space station/Legends|space station]] that orbited the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] and the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]].

==Behind the scenes==
The Hoth Republic Orbital Station was created for ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] released by [[BioWare]] on [[December 20]], [[2011]]. It serves as the spaceport for Republic players for the planet Hoth, and can only be accessed by Republic players with their own ship. Players then can take a shuttle down to [[Aurek Base]] on the planet's surface.<ref name="TOR" />
